A LITTLE PREPARATION HELPS

Bring the details.
We’ll show the way.

A school name, a preferred pickup neighbourhood and the journey you need are a good place to start.

  1. 01

    Pick your preferred route

    Shortlist the school and neighbourhood that fit your day. Note the stop name and planned pickup time.

    Explore the route finder
  2. 02

    Check the estimate

    Compare return and one-way travel, then choose a monthly or term estimate to help you plan.

    See a planning estimate
  3. 03

    Prepare your questions

    Download your enquiry to discuss with an operator. Keep personal documents for a secure, verified enrolment process.

    Prepare your enquiry

BEFORE YOU GET STARTED

A few things
worth knowing.

01Is this a bookable transport service?

This is a front-end demonstration of a school transport brand. It does not take bookings, operate vehicles, dispatch drivers or send enquiries.

02What information is saved?

Demo preferences, sample payment records and absence notes stay in your browser. No live child tracking or real payment information is collected.

03Can I use the parent portal without an account?

Yes. Use the prefilled login details to open the sample family account. There is no real authentication or private student record in this build.
